title: BoardgameQA: A Dataset for Natural Language Reasoning with Contradictory Information
reasoning: The paper discusses defeasible reasoning, where conflicts are resolved based on preferences over information sources. Section D (Limitations and Negative Societal Impact) states: 'In some applications, preferences for conflict resolution have to be assigned with great care and diligence to avoid unfair treatment of information sources.' This directly relates the core mechanism of the paper to ethical considerations of fairness and treatment of information sources.
